drive_root.previous_assumption: The Drive source was effectively represented only by one 663552000-byte tar.xz whose raw download exceeded the 104857600-byte connector limit.
drive_root.current_observation: Direct parent-constrained Drive enumeration exposes a substantial unpacked folder tree under the same clay folder. The large archive may still be individually blocked, but it is not a global blocker for Level-0 Drive assimilation.

aicore_probe.implication: A directly traversable historical FRANK source tree exists in Drive and can be assimilated without downloading the monolithic archive first.

xeno_probe.implication: Historical parser/compiler/proof/fuzz/test/replay work must be mapped against current ClayCode BASE work packages before treating those packages as greenfield.

owner_architecture_directive.directive: Digital Retina must be inside the FRANK module so FRANK is multimodal.
owner_architecture_directive.semantic_boundary: Digital Retina may use conventional physical vision code/models, pixels/tensors/embeddings, but semantic output entering FRANK must become typed provenance-bound Clay VisualPercept state. Needle remains the sole intentional non-Clay semantic subsystem.
owner_architecture_directive.harness_rule: H1/H2/H3 must preserve the same visual semantics; H3 and DOOMSDAY cannot PASS without the mandatory Digital Retina path.

progress_accounting.reason: The discovery materially changes accessibility and the future denominator, but the recursive Drive manifest is not yet frozen. No exact coverage is awarded before atomic obligations are enumerated.
progress_accounting.next_required_step: Recursively enumerate the accessible unpacked Drive tree, dedupe version/snapshot roots, classify atomic obligations, then freeze DRIVE_CLAY_MANIFEST.json.
